content: Meditation is the only answer to all the questions of man. The problem may be anything, but the answer is one: meditation is the answer.
author: Osho
sourceWork: The Book of Secrets (Vigyana Bhairava Tantra)
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Most human unhappiness exists in two places that don't currently exist: the past, which cannot be changed, and the future, which hasn't happened yet. Meanwhile, the only life you will ever experience is slipping past unnoticed.

Across his life and work, Osho saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Presence is not a rare mystical achievement; it is simply having the courtesy to show up for your own life. When you anchor your awareness in the immediate room and task, the frantic anxieties of the ego dissolve.
reflectionPrompt: Take a conscious breath right now: how much of your current stress exists only in your anticipation of tomorrow?

practicalInsight: Bring your complete, undivided attention to your next conversation or meal. Don't rehearse your reply; just listen and be there.
